headline: Pakistan expects further fuel price cuts as global oil prices fall below $100 a barrel, Finance Adviser Khurram Schehzad told Arab News, after petrol was cut by Rs9.41 and high-speed diesel by Rs5.56 per litre on Thursday.

card.desc: Aalami oil qeemat $100 fi barrel se neeche aa gayi

caption:
Petrol aur diesel mazeed saste hone ki umeed!
Arab News ke mutabiq aalami oil qeematein $115-116 fi barrel se gir kar $100 se neeche aa gayi hain, aur Finance Adviser Khurram Schehzad ko Pakistan mein fuel qeematon mein mazeed kami ki umeed hai. Thursday ko petrol Rs9.41 aur high-speed diesel Rs5.56 fi litre sasta kiya gaya tha.
Aap ke khayal mein petrol kitna sasta hona chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
